And most importantly, may you yourself be able to say: "I love this life. With all its problems, hardships, and joys, I choose to live, feeling within myself real strength and divine magnificence."
Live so that every second of your life says: "I am human, and I am here to be."

title: Union of Souls
description:
Friendship is a gift, a divine light that warms us in moments of loneliness and of joy.
The Union of Souls card reminds you that relationships built on trust, support, and sincerity are among the most precious threads connecting us to the world.
True friendship knows no envy, self-interest, or manipulation. It is like a mirror of the soul, in which we see our own reflection, sometimes bright, sometimes in need of support.
If you hold this card, ask yourself: is there someone in your life you call a friend?
Someone you can turn to at any moment, without fear of being judged?
If such a person exists, thank fate for this gift. But if you haven't written, called, or shown attention in a long while, take the first step.
Sometimes a simple "hi, how are you?" can reopen the door to a forgotten world of warmth and understanding.
Leave pride and the fear of being wrong behind. True friendship holds no grudges and stays open to renewal.
If you feel lonely, know this: the universe is always ready to connect you with those who will become kindred to your spirit.
Be open, allow yourself to meet people and let them into your life.
Sometimes new souls arrive to take the place of those who have already completed their mission on your path.
Release those who add no light to your life, and open yourself to those ready to share their warmth.
Friendship cannot be bought or sold. It cannot be forced or ordered on demand. It either exists, or it doesn't.
But if you are sincere, pure in your intentions, ready to share, friendship will surely find you.
Value your old friends, cherish them, for their presence is a sign of your worth to the world.
And let the universe grant you new allies, those with whom you'll share moments of happiness, wisdom, and life.
May your Union of Souls always be strong, bright, and full of love.

title: Shadows of Grief
description:
Grief is the shadow of life, that inevitable part of the path that cannot be avoided.
The Shadows of Grief card reminds you that this feeling is as natural as joy, and just as necessary for our soul.
Grief sharpens our feelings, awakens us to deep experience, and, at times, opens doors to a new understanding of ourselves and the world.
These emotions, like everything in life, carry their own balance.
They are like the price paid for darkness, for the depth that makes us more alive, more real. Don't fear sorrow, sadness, or grief.
They are not enemies; they are your allies, come to show you facets of life you may not have noticed.
This could be the loss of someone close, the loss of a dream, or the feeling that the world is falling apart.
But remember, this is only a temporary state, one that will pass, like everything else.
Accept your emotions; don't fight them. Live through them, feel them, call them by their names.
Don't confuse grief with pride or arrogance; these are different expressions of the soul.
Grief teaches us humility, fills our soul with the richness of experience, and makes us stronger.
To live through it means to free yourself of its weight. Thank this experience and move forward.
There are no winners in a fight against yourself.
If you feel pain right now, allow yourself to be in this state for as long as you need.
A day, a week, a month, this is your path, and it will pass.
But if you feel no grief right now, rejoice, thank life, the angels, and the Creator.
This is a sign that you are moving in harmony with your path.
Grief is not an ending. It is a moment when the soul is cleansed, the heart opens, and life prepares to give you new light.
Let this card remind you that every feeling matters, and through them we grow closer to ourselves and to the Creator.

title: Fire of Courage
description:
Courage is a fire that ignites within us when we decide to act despite fear and doubt.
Being brave doesn't mean not being afraid. It means choosing to move forward even when you don't know where the path will lead.
To achieve anything, you must take the first step. And that step is often the hardest one.
It's like learning to drive a car, ride a bike, meet new people, build a career, or start a new project.
The first step always carries discomfort, and it's important to step outside your comfort zone, as the world so often advises.
Courage doesn't live only in bold, loud deeds. It shows itself in the ability to speak the truth, even when it's uncomfortable.
In the ability to acknowledge your feelings and express them. In the readiness to let go of what no longer brings you joy, making room for something new.
Being brave means trusting yourself, even when the world around you seems chaotic.
What once seemed difficult and frightening can, with time, become easy, and one day you may be the one teaching others.
Fear fades when we act, when we decide to move forward despite uncertainty.
This card reminds you: now is the moment to light your inner fire. Do the thing you've feared for so long.
Take a step toward your dream; allow yourself to be sincere with yourself and with others.
Courage is not only a path forward, but an act of self-love that opens doors to new possibilities and inner freedom.
May the fires of your courage light your path, granting you strength, inspiration, and confidence.
Believe: the world always helps those who dare to walk toward their destiny.

title: Gift of Nourishment
description:
Food is not simply what we eat. It is a source of energy, strength, and life's vibrations.
When this card appears, it reminds us how important every moment devoted to nourishment truly is.
What we eat gives us not only physical strength, but also shapes our perception of the world and our mood.
Produce, fruit, vegetables, meat, or exotic delicacies, all of it carries its own unique energy, its own vitamins and elements, filling us with fresh strength.
When we eat the same thing every day, we get stuck in certain vibrations.
To change your life, sometimes it's enough to step outside your usual routine.
Try something new: an exotic fruit, tender meat, a delicious fish dish, or even a dessert you've long wanted to taste.
This isn't just food; it's a way to shift your energy and perception.
Sometimes it's enough to try something unusual or visit a new restaurant to awaken your senses.
Food is a great source of pleasure. Don't limit yourself if you want something delicious.
Allow yourself what you love, whether it's meat or vegetarian dishes.
What matters most is listening to yourself, your desires, and allowing yourself to enjoy the moment.
For food is one of life's greatest pleasures, and there's nothing wrong with treating yourself.
However, beyond the food itself, what matters is the energy with which we approach eating.
Recall how, before a meal, people pray or bless their food, filling it with positive energy.
Before a meal, you can give thanks for it, filling it with love and light, so the energy of the food becomes part of your wellbeing.
This is an act of awareness and respect for what gives you life.
When we eat with gratitude, we don't just become full, we fill ourselves with fresh energy.
Eating can be not only a physical process, but a spiritual one. Be mindful of how you take your meals.
If you eat with love and gratitude, your mood will shift for the better, and your food will digest with ease.
Just as in life, it matters what we choose to take in, and how it affects our inner state.
Sweets may offer instant pleasure, but remember that our energy depends on how consciously we approach every choice, whether it's food or emotion.
The gift of nourishment is not only about taste, but about the mood you create around yourself.
Fill your meals with light, warmth, and joy. Let every plate become a symbol of caring for your body, soul, and spirit.
And above all, let food not only nourish you, but inspire you toward what's new.

title: Dance of the Moon
description:
The Moon is the eternal companion of the earth and the soul. Its dance across the sky mirrors the rhythms of our inner life: the tides of emotion, the ebb of thought, the cycles of change and renewal.
During the full moon, the Moon bares the hidden parts of our being, making us feel, reconsider, and sense more deeply.
This is a moment when the thin line between light and shadow becomes especially palpable.
The full moon is a time when the Moon's light reveals the hidden corners of our soul.
In these moments, deep transformations occur, shifts in perception and mood.
Feelings may become unsteady, like waves on the ocean; they may swell like a tide and cloud the mind.
Perhaps you've noticed how, during a full moon, your mood can shift, much as it does for a woman on certain days, when the inner world begins to sway and thoughts stray from their usual course.
The Moon's energy reminds us that change is inevitable. Just as the Moon's phases follow one another, our life passes through stages of growth, stillness, and renewal.
Sometimes we grow and develop, and sometimes we fall, facing hardship, whether financial, emotional, or physical.
And though finding that golden balance is difficult, it's important to remember that in moments of storm, we are moving forward, becoming stronger and wiser.
The full moon reminds us that change is an inseparable part of the path, and within these changes we find our growth.
Don't be afraid to show your emotions, to live them fully. The Dance of the Moon invites you to be sincere and real before yourself.
This is not weakness, but strength: the ability to feel, to accept, and to change.
Just as the Moon renews its face each month, so too can you begin each day with a clean slate.
Even if you are a man, this does not diminish your strength; on the contrary, it reveals your humanity and your openness to the world.
Living through emotions enriches us, makes us more alive and more real. It is a gift that life itself gives us: experience, feeling, sensation.
Don't fear them. Don't avoid them.
Remember, emotions are a wealth that enters our life free of charge.
Don't let fear and prejudice close you off from these experiences.
Like dreams, which sometimes come and sometimes don't, emotions are something that shapes us, that makes us whole and alive.
Let your feelings be accepted, lived through, and let them lead you toward wisdom and inner cleansing.
Let this dance be a reminder that life is a constant flow, where light and shadow always take turns.
Look at the Moon, dance along with it, allowing yourself to be exactly who you are.
It lights your path even on the darkest night, filling your heart with calm and wisdom.

title: Threads of Fate
description:
Fate is woven from countless threads, each one connecting us to the events, people, and moments of our life.
What we call coincidence is, in truth, a pattern within this fabric, predetermined from above. Coincidence does not exist.
Everything that happens has its cause and its design. We often think we author our own lives, but in truth, life unfolds on its own, and we merely watch this process.
Sometimes it seems we are the authors of events, but in truth we are only viewers of a film already filmed.
This card reminds you: nothing that happens is by chance. Every event, every meeting, even the smallest details of life, are links in a chain leading you to your origins or your goals.
Sometimes these are lessons, sometimes blessings, but always part of a great design.
When you stand at a crossroads choosing a path, remember: the choice is already made, but you must accept it in order to move forward.
Every moment of life is no accident. Everything that happens, happens for a reason.
Sometimes life tests us, other times it gives us a chance, opens new possibilities.
The paths are already laid, and we merely choose which one to walk. We always choose the path that seems least difficult to us, the one that resonates within us, where the decision comes easily, without resistance.
If a thought to do something has already arisen within you, don't put it off.
Because if you don't resolve the matter now, life will present you with a situation where this same question must be faced again, possibly with greater consequences.
Everything left unresolved returns to us, so that we may complete what was begun.
All "coincidences" are the result of unresolved actions or karmic cycles that demand our attention.
Weave your fate with awareness. Every action of yours, every word, even every thought, is a thread woven into the larger pattern.
The purer your intentions, the more faith and love within your actions, the more beautiful this pattern will become.
The threads of fate never break. They may tangle, form complex knots, but they always remain with you.
Unravel them, untie them, follow them with trust. And remember: there are no mistakes in this fabric, only experience, leading you toward your true essence.

title: Who Are You?
description:
This question, "Who Are You?", is one of the most important you can ask yourself: who are you, truly?
Who are you when you're left alone with yourself, without roles, masks, or expectations?
Who is that true "you," hidden behind the facade you build for others?
This question is a mirror of your soul, through which you look at yourself.
This card asks it so that you might look deeper, beyond the familiar and the comfortable.
Life often makes us play different roles: at work we are one person, at home another, with friends a third.
But what happens when all the roles disappear? Who remains, once the masks come off?
This inner observer, this "I," is your true being. It is not bound by social frameworks, nor dependent on others' expectations.
Each of us arrives in this world with a unique task, a particular spark that is our essence.
Sometimes we choose to walk the path that seems most profitable, most sensible, for the sake of money.
But there is another calling, one that lives within us, one we cannot ignore.
It might be creativity, caregiving, teaching, or service. It is what makes us truly happy and alive.
Ask yourself an important question: what can I not not do? What brings me true satisfaction, regardless of outer circumstance?
Perhaps it's helping others, creating something new, or revealing your own soul.
Perhaps this is your true purpose: to be someone you cannot help but be.
The sooner you find your path, the sooner life will fill with meaning and harmony.
You did not arrive here by accident. Every person has their own role in the great game of the Universe.
Perhaps your role is to be a pillar for those close to you, an inspiration for friends, a creator, or a guide of wisdom.
When you recognize who you are, and accept it, your life gains clarity, and obstacles turn into opportunities.
Ask yourself this question again and again. Who are you? And be honest with yourself.
You can be many things, and that's all right. What matters is understanding what truly drives you, and why you came into this world.
Being yourself is a process, not a final destination. Accept your many facets, your uniqueness, and your purpose.

title: Tears of Rain
description:
Sadness is like rain falling upon the soil of your soul.
It arrives unexpectedly, filling the heart with weight, but like rain, it passes, leaving behind freshness and cleansing.
Sadness is not your enemy; it is a sign that you are alive, that within you there is room for emotion, for experience, for growth.
Sometimes sadness comes to help us release what no longer serves us.
It can be quiet, like a light drizzle, or fierce, like a storm.
But however it appears, remember: it is not eternal.
Having lived through it, you will feel relief, as after a long downpour, when the sun emerges from the clouds once more.
Allow yourself to live through this moment. Don't run from sadness, but don't stay stuck in it either.
It is not weakness, but an opportunity to look within yourself, to hear your true needs, and to understand what truly matters.
The more deeply you feel this emotion, the stronger your connection with yourself will become.
If you are in a state of sadness right now, remind yourself: everything passes.
Rain does not fall forever, and behind every cloud a clear sky awaits.
When you accept your feelings, sadness will leave, making room for new emotions: joy, lightness, inspiration.
Listen to your soul, as you listen to rain outside the window. Each drop is a step toward inner clarity and healing.
Allow yourself to be vulnerable, allow yourself to be real. And remember that after rain, dawn always comes.
By accepting sadness, we recognize where we stand, and can move forward.
If you are living through sadness right now, know that it will lead you to joy.
From joy comes happiness, and from happiness, love. Each stage is a movement toward a new state.
What matters most is not to stop, to know where you are, and to keep moving forward.
If you are in joy right now, take a step toward bliss, toward deep love, toward a state of all-encompassing happiness.
Remember, there is always somewhere further to go. And the path begins with awareness and action.

title: Unshakable Foundation
description:
When it seems you are alone, not knowing who will help you overcome your hardships, remember: life always offers a chance to meet someone who will become your foundation.
This person can show you the way, ground you, and help you handle tasks that seem insurmountable.
It could be a person, an event, or even an inner impulse, letting you know that you can keep moving forward.
Each of us knows the state of despair, when it feels like everything is going wrong.
But even in such moments, that very strength or support appears, helping you not to give up and to overcome obstacles.
Perhaps right now you cannot handle the situation on your own, but ask the universe to bring you a person or event that will carry the lesson you need, so you can move past this stage.
May this gift from higher powers inspire you to move forward with your head held high.
And when things grow hard again, remember that a new chance for growth will open once more.
You are not stuck, and there is always a path toward improvement.
Don't limit yourself to your own perception. Perhaps there is someone who does what you do even better, and their example will lift you to a new level.
A foundation is a ladder by which we can climb to new heights, or descend to gain new experience.
Feel this support, and continue on your path with confidence.

title: Serenity
description:
Serenity amid uncertainty is the greatest mystery and gift. We are born into it, we live by it, and every step we take is a leap into an ocean about which we know only one thing: it is boundless.
Uncertainty is life itself; it is the pulse of the Universe, its breath, filling every moment with meaning.
Imagine standing at the edge of a cliff. Before you lies a thick fog, behind which anything could be hidden: a path to happiness, an unexpected success, or even an obstacle.
But this is precisely its greatness: uncertainty is a field of endless possibility.
It does not ask whether we are ready; it simply invites us to trust.
Every moment is precious. We don't know how much time is allotted to us on this path.
This makes every minute, every breath, priceless. We make plans, we dream, but can we say with certainty what tomorrow holds?
Uncertainty reminds us of this. It whispers softly: "Live now. Feel now. Love now."
You hold this card in your hands, and it invites you to enter into a dance with the unknown.
Release your fear; don't try to control everything. Let the flow of life guide you; trust your heart.
Every unknown road can become the beginning of something great, if you allow yourself to be open.
When you begin to treasure this dance, life unfolds before you in all its magic.
Because it is uncertainty that grants the deepest feelings, the brightest moments, and the greatest revelations.
Accept it, as you accept your breath, as you accept sunlight, as you accept life itself.
Listen to this message: treasure time, because it is the one thing that truly matters.
Neither money, nor love, nor passion, nor food, nothing holds as much value as each moment we live through.
Uncertainty is precisely what makes every moment so precious.

title: Ray of Care
description:
Life will always take care of you. Accept this understanding: it is not you who takes care of your life, but life that takes care of you.
This is true magic, like a royal wisdom, reminding you that everything you need will arrive in its own time.
Life will take care of your wellbeing, your health, your love, your spiritual growth. Everything you need will be given to you.
Not more, and not less, but exactly as much as your path requires.
If something feels lacking, perhaps it's a sign: you've strayed a little from your path, or perhaps you need to learn something important, in order to become stronger and wiser.
Sometimes life teaches through hardship, through moments when it seems nothing is working out.
But know this: everything that happens, happens for your growth.
Sometimes pride, fear, or other flaws can cloud your view and make you fight battles not worth fighting.
Stop seeking answers in the wrong places; don't waste your strength on closed doors.
You alone are responsible for your setbacks, if you fail to notice the opportunities life offers you.
Life always gives a chance to become better, purer, and happier.
And right now, perhaps, the moment for change has come. If you judge your own actions, if you find yourself hiding what you do, maybe it's time to let it go?
Admit this to yourself, and open the door to new possibilities. Life will take care of you; accept its help with gratitude.

title: Song of the Soul
description:
When you came into this world, your soul came with you. It has been with you always, in every moment of your life.
And yet, we often forget about it. We become absorbed in physical existence, forgetting the subtle being living within us.
The soul can withdraw into shadow, into loneliness, into sadness, when we stop hearing and valuing it.
It suffers when we forget it, when we live as though it did not exist.
Stop, and listen to your soul. Close your eyes and simply feel it.
Say: "Hello, my soul, I am here. Thank you for being with me; forgive me for forgetting you, for not always valuing you, for not always turning to you with love."
Acknowledge its importance, deep within your heart. The soul is not an abstraction; it is the most important part of your path.
Forgive yourself, and forgive your soul, for the moments you turned away from it.
Acknowledge that life has taught you to forget it, that your parents, your surroundings, the world sometimes teach you not to hear or feel your soul.
Forgive yourself for the suffering you have caused yourself and your soul.
The soul has many facets. It is not uniform, not one single face. In different situations it may play different roles: passionate, quiet, kind, or strong.
And each of us, as a soul, is likewise many-sided. The soul of a poet, a musician, a mother, a driver, it lives within each of us, in every expression of our life.
If you've drawn this card, it is a sign. A sign that your soul demands attention and care.
May your soul bloom, opening to new possibilities. It carries within it the keys to your happiness, your strength, and your life's resources.
Feel its light and its power; it can guide you through any hardship.
Remember, without your soul you cannot overcome anything. Only the soul has the power to transform, to give you clarity, and to direct your thoughts along the right course.
Thoughts govern the body, and the soul governs thoughts. When you connect with your soul, you open the path to healing and harmony.
The soul is the source of your true path. Give it the chance to reveal itself.
Awaken it, and it will lead you to the life you deserve.

title: Ode to Life
description:
Thank you, life. This is not merely gratitude; it is a deep acknowledgment that you have always been there.
You never left me, even when it seemed I was on the edge. You always found a way to support me, guide me, give me hope.
Thank you for every moment you were with me, never leaving me alone.
Thank you, life, for giving me my parents, for letting me see this world, experience its beauty and its hardships.
Thank you for every moment, every breath, every trial that made me stronger.
You, life, are not merely existence; you are a process of discovery and growth.
Feel these words. You are able to read these lines. This is a gift not everyone can grasp. And for that, thank you.
Your eyes see, your mind understands, your soul perceives. This is the most divine moment you could experience in your life.
Gratitude is the magic that makes our life fuller. Thank yourself, thank everything that brought you here.
Thank you for being open to this magic, to this path. The power of gratitude opens even more gifts before us.
The more we say "thank you," the more miracles enter our lives.
Thank you, life, for the lessons, for this meeting with this moment, with these cards, with this knowledge.
I give thanks for the trust, for the chance to be here, with you, to help you, to serve you.
This system will not deceive you; it is sincere, honest, and beautiful, like life itself. It gives answers when we are ready to receive them.
It doesn't matter how many decks of cards exist in the world. All of them carry their own power.
But these cards are for those who are ready to change their life.
Who understand that this is not merely a game, but a path worth walking with gratitude.
Welcome to a new tale of angels and demons, and of the one Creator.

title: Walk Along the Bottom
description:
Being at rock bottom is that moment when everything seems lost. The money has run out, the strength, the motivation.
It is a state where debts weigh you down, work is absent, or it feels as though life has turned its back on you.
Sometimes you leave everything familiar behind, cross out your past, and stand with empty hands and an open soul to step into an unknown future.
This is point zero. It is frightening here, painful, lonely. This is a place where fear and doubt cut deep, and gray hairs may appear at your temples.
But it is exactly at this point that the greatest transformation occurs. From the bottom, you can always push off.
This is not only a challenge, but a gift hidden within the hardest trial.
At the bottom, you see the truth. Who is with you, and who is pulling you down?
Who truly stands by you, and who is only an illusion of support? These moments are rare, but they are the keys to your rebirth.
If you are sincere, honest with yourself and the world, if light lives within you, this trial will become the start of a new chapter.
But if the bottom is the result of mistakes, harmful habits, negative actions, then the time for cleansing has come.
Ask forgiveness of those you've hurt; free your soul of its burden; reconsider your paths.
The bottom is not a punishment, but a challenge. A test of your strength, your kindness, your faith.
If you sincerely change yourself, begin to live honestly, with love and respect, the way up will surely open.
Life gives lessons not to destroy us, but so we can become stronger and wiser.
If you have never been at the bottom, give thanks for that every day. If you are there now, know: it is temporary.
Walk through the pain, learn to trust yourself, forgive yourself and others, and you will surely rise higher than you were before.
Let this card remind you that even in the deepest darkness there is a chance to see light.
And that light is within you.

title: Mystery of Presence
description:
Something is hidden from us, something awaits us, but is not yet known.
Something is about to happen, and it will be positive, joyful, and important. Now is the time to cut the ties with the past.
Release everything that stands in the way of moving forward. What is false, what is untrue, all of it must go.
Say to yourself: "I release everything holding me back from happiness."
I repent, and I free myself from everything that slows my growth, my love for myself and for this world.
Something is happening, something important. That something is you. You are the most precious thing you have right now.
This is what must be cherished, what requires your attention and care. Work on your purity, on your love of life.
Serve the world, leaving behind a bright trail rather than bitterness and partings.
There is no need to stain your life, no need to hurt others. Act by the laws of love and justice.
There is no need to go against your own nature, no need to take what isn't meant for you. Otherwise, you choose the path of darkness.
A path that can become destructive. Do not be dishonest, either with yourself or with others.
Accept yourself as you are, in light or in shadow. But don't deceive yourself; don't kill your soul.
This card reminds you that everything exists at once: emptiness and fullness, truth and falsehood.
Everything joins into one whole, and you are part of it.
Find your path to harmony, remaining yourself, without lies or illusion.

title: Being in Flow
description:
Wildness is an energy that arrives spontaneously, like a powerful current, unbound by time or space.
It can seize us in the most unexpected moments and carry us into a flow where everything becomes clear.
Sometimes we ourselves become part of this flow, simply following it, without burdening ourselves with unnecessary questions.
What matters in this moment is being in accord with yourself and the world.
Free yourself from the weight of the past; release everything holding you back from harmony. There's no need to cling to old grievances, fears, and misconceptions.
Release them, and feel how your soul is freed. This requires no effort, only sincerity and the recognition that not everything needs to be understood and controlled.
Being in flow means not fearing change, but trusting life.
And when this flow passes through you, you realize that nothing is ever accidental.
Everything you experience teaches you, opens new horizons, and gives you the chance to understand yourself better.
In this process, it's important not to fight yourself, not to try to prove you're right. Everything happens as it should.
And if you have found your path, if you are ready to accept everything life brings, you will become stronger.
Shamanism, magic, energy, these are not always about drawing power from the outer world.
Often they are about learning to work with what is already within you.
When you understand your own inner strength, you no longer need to look for it elsewhere.
You yourself become the source of your own light, someone who moves through life with an open heart.
Not everyone is ready to understand the depth of what happens in this world.
Many chase money, fame, or power, without understanding that true strength lies elsewhere.
It lies in the ability to see, to be, and to remain honest with yourself. This path isn't always easy, but it is always real.
The choice is yours. Accepting your path, finding your true essence, or continuing to search for it outside yourself, this is your choice.
But remember, every moment, every word, every action carries meaning.
And perhaps, right now, you are ready to hear what you have tried so long to understand.

title: Being Yourself
description:
This card reminds you: true freedom begins with sincerity toward yourself.
To be means accepting yourself completely, with all your feelings, thoughts, and experiences, without masks or conditions.
Sincerity means allowing yourself to live in harmony with your inner world, without striving to match others' expectations.
The sincerity of Being invites you to look within and ask: where am I hiding my true essence?
Perhaps you too often wear roles that create a sense of safety, but distance you from your true self. Free yourself from them.
Accept your strengths and your weaknesses, your achievements and your mistakes. It is exactly within this acceptance that your strength is born.
Sincerity is not perfection, but naturalness. It is forgiving yourself for your imperfections, releasing self-criticism, and caring for yourself as your closest friend.
Let your body be a home where love and care reign.
Give up the habit of comparing yourself to others, striving toward standards imposed from outside. Sincerity needs no justification.
Learn to speak truth to your own heart: what do you want? What do you fear? What brings you joy?
Sincerity is the ability to listen to yourself, to follow your desires and needs, without fear of being misunderstood.
It is also the ability to respect another's truth, without demanding that others match your expectations.
The Being Yourself card reminds you that living in your own truth is a profound act of self-love.
When you begin to be honest with yourself, the world answers you in kind.
The people, events, and opportunities that come to you will resonate with your true essence.
Being yourself is not a struggle; it is a dance with life.
It is the ability to enjoy the moment, to care for your body, to clear your thoughts and emotions of what's unneeded.
Let your presence be filled with light, and let your words and actions reflect your soul.
Accept yourself as you are, and you will feel lightness and harmony entering your life.
Sincerity is not only a way of being yourself, but a key to discovering a world where there is no need to hide behind masks.
Live in your truth, and you will see life fill with meaning, beauty, and freedom.

title: Illusion of Reality
description:
It's hard to take action, isn't it? This is a state of powerlessness, when everything seems tangled and unclear.
It seems we start saying one thing, but along the way the thought gets lost, and suddenly it turns out that what matters isn't the words, but what they leave behind.
Chasing after words, we often get lost in illusions, forget where we're headed, forget who we are.
This is a state where life turns into automatism, and we lose touch with reality.
But somewhere deep inside, we know: what matters is not what we lose, but what we gain.
We live in a world where our higher selves and consciousness govern us, while we believe we are governing ourselves.
The game of this reality is like a labyrinth in which we get tangled, lose our way, forget that in truth, all of this is a game.
We play, we fight, we learn, we die, and we begin the game again.
And here's the question: what game are you playing right now? A game of love, or of revenge? Of happiness, or of suffering?
What role do you take on? Isn't it true that the game is simply a choice?
And if you feel you want to step out of this game, to change the rules, you have every right to.
Ask for space to heal; ask forgiveness for your sins, whether before yourself, before the Earth, or before those you've hurt.
A prayer spoken with a sincere heart will be heard. There are no accidents. Everything happening to you carries meaning.
Every moment, every step, is not simply a move in the game, but a path of awakening.
Awakening is not an accident; it is your decision. You are responsible for your own reality.
And if there are entities or other forces in your world affecting you, it is likely that, at some unconscious level, you once gave them permission to "live" alongside you.
Every path, every experience is part of your choice, part of the game.
But it's important to recognize that reality is one, and it holds power.
Open your eyes, even if only for a moment, and see the truth hidden behind the illusions. Don't live in delusion.
Awaken. Accept this world, whatever it may be, a world of temptations, sufferings, games, and joys.
This is a world your soul chose to be in, in order to learn, to live, to become aware. Your path is your choice.
Amen.

title: Art of the Master
description:
Mastery is not merely a skill; it is a state that arrives when you give yourself fully to your work, becoming a channel for energy, for an idea, or for meaning.
The Art of the Master card speaks to the truth that two facets live within each of us: the person, and the master.
The person is you, with all your feelings, weaknesses, joys, and sorrows.
This is the one who wants to love, laugh, cry, be vulnerable, or simply enjoy the moment.
The master is you, when you are focused, when you work, create, help others, negotiate, or even cook dinner.
The master shows itself when you take responsibility for a task, for the flow passing through you.
But there is an important balance here: the master must not overshadow the person.
Imagine a pilot who, upon leaving the cockpit, continues acting like a pilot when speaking with family or friends.
Or a doctor who brings home their medical diagnoses. If mastery is not left at the threshold of life, it will begin to displace your personality, filling your life with a single, narrow meaning.
The master lives within the moment of action, of creation. But once the action is complete, mastery must give way to simple human being.
This matters not only for preserving your inner harmony, but so that your work, your help, your energy remain sincere and real.
This card reminds you that being a master is a gift, but also a responsibility. You are not a master all the time.
You are a master in the moment it's needed. The rest of the time, you are simply human.
This lets you avoid burning out, lets you preserve yourself, and keeps you from carrying your personal experiences, fears, or weaknesses into your professional work.
If this card has come to you, consider: where are you a master, and where are you simply human? How do you separate these roles?
Perhaps you've become too absorbed in one of them? Remember, life is a balance.
And your strength lies in being in harmony with yourself.
Be a master in what you love, in what you do. But don't forget to be human.
Mastery is part of you, but not the whole of your being. Find the balance, and your life will become whole and many-sided.

title: Law of Harmony
description:
One of the greatest laws of the Universe is: do not judge. True wisdom comes through acceptance, not judgment.
When we judge others, we forget that the world is structured so that every judgment has its reverse side.
Oh, how often, at the very moment we begin to judge, life can turn around and hand us back those same accusations, not from someone else, but from the very people we once judged.
Events can shift in an instant, and what seemed wrong or unacceptable can become part of our own fate.
Remember: "Judge not, lest you be judged." This is not a call to ignore the imperfections of others, but to accept them as they are.
Yes, someone may irritate you, something may displease you, but this is no reason to judge. None of us is perfect.
We don't always know the whole truth, and our judgments may be nothing more than illusion.
When someone's actions displease you, don't be quick to judge. This may be a lesson for you, not for them.
Don't deceive yourself, don't try to place yourself above others. If someone's opinion or words have struck a nerve, perhaps this is the moment to reflect.
Why does this trigger you? Why does it bother you? Perhaps it's a sign that you need to look inward and cleanse your soul.
My purpose is not to cause pain, but to show you where your own unrecognized fears and issues are hiding, the ones that need to be released.
Your healing begins with you, and I am only here to help you realize this.
Every word and action of yours carries weight. When you judge others, you inevitably draw the same judgments into your own life.
The world is a mirror. We receive what we give. Don't wait for someone else to clear away your inner clutter for you.
This is your work, your responsibility. Don't think that saving others is the path to your own happiness.
If you manipulate, if you use others, this will only create more confusion and pain.
Be honest with yourself, because only through sincerity can true peace be found.
If you feel a situation calls for your intervention or your judgment, think instead about what you want to change within yourself.
For change begins inside you. Remember: there's no need to deceive yourself, no need to convince others of something if you yourself aren't sure you're right.
This will lead to nothing good. Be honest with yourself, and the world will mirror your honesty back to you.
Let every moment be a lesson for your growth. Let judgment stay in the past, and let acceptance and love remain in the present.

title: Phobias
description:
Phobias are not simply fear; they are an endless closed wheel of doubt and insecurity, in which we turn like gears in a mechanism, returning again and again to the same thoughts and situations.
This is not just anxiety; it is a state in which we create our own obstacles inside our heads, sometimes without noticing how these thoughts seize us and pull us into an endless loop.
Phobias are thoughts that once clouded us, that we wind up like old tape, and these thoughts become our state of being.
We begin to believe something will go wrong, and the fears start gaining strength, drawing energy out of us.
But in truth, this is only an illusion, our own inner whirlwind, in which we lose control.
Simply begin to think differently: everything will be fine. Everything will work out. The solutions have already arrived, and the scariest part is already behind you.
Relax, and release these fears. All you need is to trust the process and believe you are moving in the right direction.
Relax, let go, and you will reach what you're striving for, so long as your actions don't threaten your own safety, and you're not putting yourself in danger.
In that case, this isn't a phobia, but a real fear, one that requires your attention and action.
But if your fears are merely thoughts, not grounded in a real threat, let them go.
Don't feed your phobias; don't sustain them. Say goodbye to them.
For there is nothing in this world deserving of your fear, if you are willing to let go and believe that everything will be fine.

title: Hidden Facets
description:
Secrets. Each of us keeps our own, and sometimes those of others too.
There are secrets that must never be revealed, under any circumstances. They remain beyond words and glances.
These secrets are our own private territory, and, despite everything, it's important to learn to respect them.
The greatest gift is not to gossip, not to spread rumors, and not to speak ill of others.
There's no need to discuss behind someone's back what doesn't concern you.
Secrets are not only what we keep in our own hearts, but what belongs to others.
And if someone has entrusted you with their secret, guard it like a treasure, protecting it from prying eyes.
Don't forget your conscience. Nothing in life matters more than honesty and truth.
Each of us can make the mistake of saying too much, or breaking someone's trust. You may regret it, or you may not.
But a true conscience always gives us clues. Listen to it.
Taking responsibility for your words and actions is what makes us mature.
Don't shift blame onto others; don't use people for your own selfish ends.
Respect and honesty are the foundation on which real relationships are built.
Each of us plays our own role in this life. Some labor in the shadows, others in plain sight, but no one is any less important.
We all teach one another. Respect and the value of each person, this is what allows us to move forward.
And perhaps the most important lessons come from those we once failed to understand.
Not every secret needs words; not every secret needs revealing.
Listen to your conscience, respect others, and remember that all of life is a great lesson we walk through together.

title: Scarlet Shame
description:
Shame. This feeling is familiar to everyone, but how often do we let it govern us?
Shame is not a vice, but simply an emotion, like so many others.
It arises when we make mistakes, or say something other than what we meant.
Sometimes we feel ashamed of words we've spoken, of deeds we've done, or of a truth we chose to voice.
But isn't this emotion normal? There's no need to hide from it, for shame reminds us that we are alive, that we are not perfect, that we are learning and growing.
Sometimes shame comes when we speak a truth that might hurt others.
And then a question arises: "Should I feel ashamed of this?" But is it truly shameful to speak the truth?
We fear hurting someone, but it's important to remember: speaking the truth is not a mistake.
What matters is being honest with yourself and with others, and though this may cause pain, truth always cleanses the soul.
Shame is a natural feeling; you can live with it. It won't destroy you if you accept it as part of your path.
Everyone feels ashamed at times, but it's important to learn to release it. Admit it to yourself, let go of past mistakes, and don't let them pull you backward.
When you forgive yourself, shame loses its power.
Forgive yourself for the moments you felt shame, and forgive others who may, at some point, have hurt you too.
We all make mistakes. What matters is that you recognize them, learn from them, and move forward, not hiding your feelings of shame, but accepting them as part of your experience.
Shame does not make us worse; it reminds us that we strive to be better.
Acknowledging our mistakes is the path to cleansing. When you admit you were wrong, you free yourself of the burden.
Let this feeling leave you, and don't be afraid to be honest anymore.
With every act of forgiveness, shame departs, and your soul grows lighter.

title: Time of Darkness
description:
Sometimes darkness arrives, and this is not always a sign of misfortune. On the contrary, it is the beginning of a path, when we face what we fear, and must accept it as part of our journey.
We often fear the dark sides of our soul, the emotions we hide within ourselves.
But it's important to understand: darkness is not the enemy. It is a space in which not only fears hide, but also opportunities for growth.
How many times do we fear what we don't understand? The fear that a curse might fall upon us, that some force might interfere in our life... But if we live honestly, if our actions are pure, if we cause no harm to ourselves or others, then darkness cannot overshadow us.
Instead of fearing it, learn to work with this energy. Darkness is not always a destructive force.
It can cleanse, it can heal, even if this isn't always obvious. Learn to engage with this energy.
In each of its expressions, something of value can be found. It is like a cleansing, a release of what is unneeded.
Yes, it takes, but it also gives. Darkness teaches us to live in harmony with ourselves, with our emotions and experiences.
Being honest with yourself and with those around you is one of the greatest gifts we can give ourselves and the world.
But what does it mean to be honest? Do we always find that one true truth, or is truth only found along the way, in the searching?
Can we ever fully understand what truth is, and speak it, without fear of the consequences?
Being honest doesn't mean never making mistakes. It means accepting your mistakes and learning from them.
Darkness takes our thoughts, sometimes devalues them. But this doesn't mean it is bad.
We still wake up, and the world continues on, sometimes in brighter, purer colors.
And perhaps darkness isn't as frightening as it seems. It gives us the strength to endure hardship, to understand our emotions, to experience them fully.
What matters is how we handle this energy. Aggression, pain, tension, these are not always something destructive.
Sometimes, by living through these states, we learn to find our way to ourselves and to our goals.
Darkness gives us energy for change, for a new stage in life.
When you face darkness, don't fear it. Use it as a source of strength.
Reach out to the resources it can offer you.
And remember, darkness is not an ending, but a new step on your path.
Energy must always circulate, to maintain balance. Share it with those around you, and it will return to you as opportunities, as strength, as changes that help you move forward.
Darkness comes to teach us important lessons. Accept it as part of your path, and move forward, unafraid of what hides within its depths.

title: Truth of the Soul
description:
A kiss does not lie; it reaches into the soul, touches the heart, and leaves its mark in the deepest corner of your being.
A true, sincere kiss needs no words; it reveals feeling without demanding proof.
So too is sincerity between people: it is felt, and it cannot be faked.
We all sense when we are being lied to, and when we are told the truth.
Lies have always been, and will always be, part of our world, and it's important to learn to work with this.
We can either accept it, or reject it. But what matters most is living in truth.
Sometimes the truth is bitter. We don't always rejoice when hidden things come to light, but it is necessary.
This is the moment to take responsibility for your life and for everything happening within it.
Only we ourselves can answer for what happens to us.
We don't always realize that we control our own reality; sometimes it feels as if we are merely actors in someone else's script, as if someone else governs our choices and actions.
And in such moments, it's hard to know where our responsibility ends, and where someone else's will begins.
And yet, it's important to remember that our entire life is our own decision.
We can be either puppets in the hands of circumstance, or powerful creators of our own destiny.
It all depends on the level at which we stand, on how we accept ourselves and the world around us.
Taking responsibility for your life is the path to freedom and awareness.
When you take it on, you free yourself from illusion and begin to live in harmony with yourself and with the world.
Such is this card. Honor the truth of the Soul, strive always to be honest, and life will then look upon you with favor.

title: Petal of Praise
description:
Praise yourself. Praise yourself for every step, every decision, everything that brought you to this moment.
For the work you have put into your life, for the deeds that make you who you are.
Praise yourself for your humanity, for your ability to see the right paths and follow them, for solving problems, taking responsibility, and moving forward.
We often forget to acknowledge our own effort; we forget to say "thank you" to ourselves.
So often we fail to notice what we've already achieved, losing sight of the fact that every one of our steps is already a victory.
A victory over yourself, over doubt, over fear. This is your strength, a strength revealed in every moment of struggle with yourself.
You have already won, and that victory is yours.
Sometimes thoughts carry us into dark corners of doubt, and we lose touch with what truly matters.
But it's important to remember: give thanks to yourself for who you are.
For walking this Earth, for living in this world, in this universe.
We may never know for certain if other worlds, other forms of life exist, but what matters is that you are here, you are alive, you feel this moment, and that alone is a miracle.
Thank yourself for your spirit moving forward, for hearing the signs that guide you along the right course.
Thank yourself for your ability to make decisions, for your ability to move in the right direction, no matter what.
Praise opens doors to new possibilities. It fills the soul with light and warmth.
The more you thank yourself, the more comes to you: the right signs, intuition, help from beyond.
Thank yourself for your ability to hear your own intuition, for going where your true place awaits you.
Say to yourself: "I thank myself. I thank myself for everything I have lived and am living. I thank myself for my strength, for my choices, for the light, and even for the mistakes that made me wiser."
Let these words become a mantra for you, a powerful reminder of how important it is to value your own soul.
Thank yourself now, fully, wholeheartedly. For every one of your movements, every one of your sensations, every moment of this life.
Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.

title: Path of Integration
description:
Integration is the path that leads you toward wholeness. It is the process of merging every aspect of your experience, every lesson you have already begun to learn, and every path still ahead of you.
Sometimes we linger at a certain stage, never quite completing it.
And so this card reminds you: the time has come to move on, to pass from one stage to another, to become wiser, more aware, and stronger.
This is not simply movement; it is a path of awareness. Every moment, every step, even the smallest experiences, are an important part of your growth.
Remember that you create your own reality, and every moment you live through gives you strength.
It matters to feel that what you're doing right now matters, for you and for the Universe.
I give you this card as a symbol of divine manifestation. With every card, with every energy you invest, you become part of a greater process, a process of healing, growth, and transformation.
Your thoughts, ideas, and energy affect the world, and this is no accident.
This moment of creation matters, for you and for those who will encounter these cards.
You are creating a merging of energy, and when someone draws this card, let it bring them insight and healing.
Good thoughts and good intentions are passed on, and each of us can heal, even through simple yet powerful tools like these cards.
When you give from the heart, you give not only to others, but to yourself. The energy returns, and it will heal you too.
Giving is an expression of divine love. Give, from the heart, what you yourself would wish to receive.
The more generously you give, the more possibilities open for you. Let it be an act of love for yourself and for those around you.
Especially when you give something meaningful to people who matter to you, at just the right moment, this is a true gift to the Universe.
Live your life fully, with feeling and emotion, with intention and awareness. Let there be something to tell your children, your grandchildren.
Love life, despite its hardships. And if there are no children in your life, this doesn't mean it lacks meaning.
Perhaps you will have children one day, or perhaps you won't, and that's all right. For we are all connected.
We are like a matrix, growing, developing, creating new lives, new connections.
Integration is accepting every side of life. Sometimes it's important to free yourself from old attachments in order to move forward.
No suffering, tears, or pain should stand in your way. You can free yourself from the past; cut it away like with a knife.
Let go, so you can begin living anew.
Sometimes this is hard, but everything is possible. Life gives us the strength for change.
Cast off unneeded thoughts and free yourself for a new path. This can, and should, be integrated, without fixating on what has already been.
Life is a choice, and you choose how to live it: with joy, with pleasure, or with disappointment.
Your choices are your possibilities.
Now is the time for new energy, for a new path. Travel, enjoy yourself, allow yourself moments of pleasure. Integrate delight into your life.
If you want to travel, go to new places, buy things for yourself, savor every moment.
Life is one, and it should be full of joy.
Don't stop; keep moving forward, and let every moment be filled with true delight, true happiness.
Integrate this into your life, and your world will become bright and full!

title: Fire of the Quest
description:
Searching is an inseparable part of our being. We are forever searching: for love, for money, for answers to our questions, for solutions, for healing.
We search for resources, strength, inspiration, and life's meaning. This is a path we inevitably walk, like ants that always search for food, build their nests, and bring home what's needed.
So too, a person, by their very nature, is always in search of something important.
But it's important to remember that searching doesn't always imply a final goal.
Sometimes we search for something and don't find it, and this can be a sign.
Maybe we're searching for the wrong thing, or in the wrong way.
Or maybe what we're searching for isn't ready for us yet, or perhaps we don't need it right now.
Perhaps it's worth asking: are we asking the right questions? And isn't the very path we walk the most precious treasure of all?
For along the path of searching, we learn and grow, and every step brings new awareness.
In our searching, we ourselves once planted the clues that, in time, will let us remember who we are and why we are here.
We came into this world with a particular purpose, with a plan we wish to fulfill.
These clues we've left ourselves help us find the way back to ourselves, returning us to what we once intended.
And the moment we begin recognizing these signs, we move forward, toward fulfilling what we came into this world for.
Searching is not merely striving toward a goal. It is a game, a game with life, which should never be boring.
Let every step along the path of your search be a lesson for you, and every moment a source of strength.
And remember, whoever finds what they were searching for will be rich in spirit and in the fullness of life.

title: Road into Mystery
description:
The unknown is a space that always waits for your step into its uncharted depth.
It's easy to follow others' paths, to copy their successes, and, imitating them, to achieve what someone else has already found.
But true strength lies not in repeating others' successes, but in daring to step into the unknown, into that region of life and consciousness hidden from most eyes.
This is a place where you can reveal the uniqueness that exists only within you.
The unknown is a search for yourself. It is a space where you find your personal gifts, your true strengths, which can become a source of creative inspiration and profound change.
This is not merely studying outer practices or techniques, such as tarot, reiki, or esoteric studies, which can, of course, enrich your life, but the true unknown lies in uncovering your inner world.
It is the search for what you can offer this world, drawing from your own deep uniqueness.
When you begin to explore the unknown within yourself, you will discover new possibilities and abilities that had, until now, been hidden.
This requires effort, patience, and a willingness to see in yourself what once seemed impossible. Finding your uniqueness is a process.
It is not merely following others' ideas, but forging your own path, one that leads to personal fulfillment and strength.
The unknown can show itself in many different areas of life: in relationships, in family bonds, in your profession, in spiritual practice.
Each of these areas can become a field where new facets of your potential lie hidden.
All you need is the courage to step into the unknown and trust what you discover there.
Imagine yourself as a diamond with many facets. Each facet reflects a different aspect of your personality: your weaknesses, your strengths, your grievances and your cleansing, your divinity and your creative power.
When you accept all of these facets and allow yourself to step beyond the familiar, you discover entirely new horizons.
The zone of the unknown is a zone of growth. It is not a place for risks that threaten your safety, but a zone where you confront your own fear and doubt, in order to overcome them and open new possibilities for yourself.
That moment when you feel afraid, when you want to say "no", it is exactly there, at that point of fear, that your zone of growth lies.
And the more you walk toward it, the more astonishing the gifts you'll be able to receive.
The unknown is calling. And to find new treasures, you must step beyond the familiar.
Accept this challenge, and follow into the unknown; be yourself, and reveal your true strength.

title: The Third Eye
description:
The third eye is a gift we often forget, or fail to fully recognize.
It is the ability to see and to feel what is hidden from the ordinary observer's eyes.
This is intuition, which helps us make decisions, uncover hidden truths, and guide us toward the path we truly need.
Some develop this gift consciously, while others pay it no attention at all.
But the Third Eye card reminds you of the importance of this source of power within you.
Intuition is not merely a hunch or instinctive knowledge. It is an inner voice, always near, ready to help, if we learn to hear it.
If this card has appeared in your reading, open your heart and mind to your own third eye.
Let your intuition begin working for you. Listen to it, trust it, and follow its guidance.
It can lead you along paths not immediately obvious; it can suggest which decisions will serve you best, and help you avoid false steps.
This is a path where it matters not only to follow the voice of intuition, but to consciously decide when and how to use its signals.
It's important to learn to tell when intuition is showing you the truth, and when your fears or desires are distorting it.
This gift requires practice and inner honesty. True intuition is not tangled in illusion; it is clear and precise, like a mirror reflecting reality without filters or distortion.
Intuition is a key to your development, one that helps unlock your gifts and abilities.
It helps you walk the path that will lead you to happiness, health, and success, if, of course, you choose that path.
But remember that every path demands its lessons. At every level of life, whether material or spiritual, there are tasks that must be passed through.
And though intuition may point you in the right direction, the path will still demand your responsibility and effort.
Don't let others' opinions overshadow your inner voice. What matters is what you think, what your heart and your soul feel.
Only pure intuition, undistorted by outer factors, can lead you to the genuine truth that exists for you.
This is a gift, to see the world as it truly is, without masks or illusion.
If you are ready to listen to and follow your third eye, you will open before yourself a path to deep wisdom and true wellbeing.
May your intuition become your guide, leading you through life with confidence and light.

title: Angel of Reconciliation
description:
There are moments in life when we are at odds with others, when our relationships call for healing.
This discord can drag negative energy behind it, draining our strength and creating invisible channels through which our energy flows into emptiness, leaving us depleted.
The Angel of Reconciliation card brings you a message: the time has come to heal and close this energetic cycle.
If there are unresolved conflicts or situations in your life, where reconciliation should long ago have arrived, the angels call you to recognize this moment.
Reconciliation is not only about restoring outer bonds, but about returning inner balance.
It frees the soul from heavy chains, breaks old contracts, and lets you move forward without carrying the weight of the past.
Allow the angels to bring you onto this path. They bless you toward forgiveness, toward completing what keeps you from living in harmony and light.
But remember, reconciliation is a choice. You must be ready for it.
When you allow it to happen, you consent to being set free. And if you're not ready, that too is all right.
Your energy and your decisions are always your own.
But if you're open to this process, if there is readiness in your heart to release grievance and discord, then the miracle of reconciliation can enter your life.
It will bring you peace and harmony, restore your inner strength, and fill your heart with light.
The path of reconciliation is a path of liberation, one that brings true freedom and clarity.
Let the angels guide you along this path, and know that healing always begins with you.

title: Source of Strength
description:
Strength, like everything in this world, is not something fixed or permanent.
This is not the one card that holds more power than the others.
It is the whole deck, the whole energy running through every moment of your life.
The strength it represents depends on where you choose to direct it.
It will not work on your behalf; it only offers you a resource you can use to activate your own potential.
The power of a card is not something you can simply receive or take. It is a process.
It is the ability to recognize its presence, to feel it, and to direct it toward what matters to you.
When you are open to this power, grateful for it, it begins to work with you.
The more grateful and attentive you are, the stronger its effect will be.
However, like any gift, strength requires attention and respect.
If you're not grateful for it, if you don't notice where it goes, it can vanish. Energy, like work, requires balance.
If you don't give it its due, it will not stay with you.
But if you understand where to direct your strength, if you're grateful for its support, it will fill you.
Strength does not come without purpose; it comes only when you have intention and clarity about what you wish to create in your life.
As in any act of creation, your sincerity matters. When you work with strength, be honest with yourself and with the world.
Your true intention, your authentic self, draws this energy in and directs it where it's needed.
Ask yourself: what do I want to create with this strength? And let your inner direction be clear and true.
Strength always works for those who are sincere and ready for change.
Accept it, release it, thank it, and watch as it begins to work with you.
The task is to learn to use it to realize your potential, to create what truly matters to you.
This is your path, your growth, and the Strength card is an invitation to walk this path, living it fully, sincerely, and with blessing.

title: Prayer
description:
Prayer is not merely words; it is a profound act of connection with higher powers, a moment of pure communion with what lies beyond our understanding.
Regardless of whom you address, whether Jesus, Buddha, Shiva, Krishna, or Allah, prayer always carries power when it comes from a pure heart.
Before you pray, find solitude. It matters that your space be calm, and your surroundings harmonious.
Pray in silence, in a place where your heart can open, and your thoughts can settle.
Let it be a place of power, whether a sacred space beyond you, or a corner of your own home where you can feel your connection to the world and the Universe.
Prayer doesn't always require grand requests. Sometimes it's enough simply to give thanks that you are alive, that the Universe is still with you, that your contract with this world continues.
Gratitude is the foundation of true prayer. Prayer can be for health, for peace, for love, for inner calm.
What matters most is sincerity.
Remember, a prayer coming from a pure heart is always heard. It requires no material desires; it asks for no millions.
What matters is asking with purity of intention and openness to this world.
Prayer opens hearts; it fills the soul with light, and in this process, the most important thing is to be real.
Pray often, trusting that every word of yours carries power, and let prayer become a channel for the highest blessings into your life.

title: Sleeping Soul
description:
This card speaks to the depths of your being, reminding you of the part of you that lies wrapped in stillness, waiting to awaken.
The Sleeping Soul symbolizes a state where your inner light seems to have dimmed, and the voice of your soul is barely heard.
But even in the deepest slumber, the soul continues to live, awaiting your attention and care.
The sleeping soul does not lose its power; it is only hidden behind a veil of routine, disappointment, and the pursuit of the material.
Its sleep is not an end, but a pause, so you can recognize its importance.
Ask yourself: do I hear my soul? What does its sleep conceal?
Perhaps it is exhaustion from chasing illusions, or pain left unattended.
The soul awaits your awakening, alongside its own. It wants to be heard, so it can guide you toward true joy and harmony.
Speak to it words of forgiveness and love: "My soul, forgive me for forgotten dreams, for the long years of silence.
Accept my promise to care for you, to hear you, and to live in accord with your desires."
The soul's sleep is not weakness, but a chance for reconsideration.
Sometimes it withdraws deep within to protect you from unnecessary noise, from energy that destroys.
But the time has come to bring it back into your awareness, to let its light and strength into your life.
Allow it to guide you, releasing what's excessive and unneeded.
Awaken your soul. Hear its whisper, feel its power. Let it become your guide, your source of inspiration and wisdom.
Say to yourself: "I am ready to live in accord with myself. May my soul awaken, and may its light illuminate my path.
May I find joy, peace, and true happiness, uncovering my true nature."
This card reminds you that the soul never truly leaves, even when it seems to sleep.
It awaits your attention, your love, and your readiness to live in harmony with its light. The time of awakening has come.
Trust your soul, and let it show you the way to true happiness and inner freedom.

title: Finding Home
description:
A home is more than walls, a roof, and an address. It is a symbol of your personal space, your fortress, where you find shelter from the world, where you can be yourself.
The Finding Home card speaks to a deep inner desire to find your place under the sun, a space that becomes your source of strength and confidence.
Many of us dream of a home, whether a cozy apartment in the city center, a small house by the sea, or a native corner of the world where you are always awaited.
But a home is not only a physical space; it is a state of the soul.
It is a place where you feel safety, support, and joy, where every morning begins with warmth, and every evening ends with gratitude.
If you already have a home, this is a gift worth cherishing.
If you are still searching for it, this card reminds you: everything arrives in its own time.
Perhaps you haven't yet found the exact place that will become your home, but this doesn't mean you won't find it.
Let this journey become your conscious choice: to understand where you want to be, with whom you want to share this space, and what the word "home" means for you.
Home doesn't necessarily mean walls. It can be family, a beloved person, or even simply a place within you where you feel whole.
If it seems you've been shortchanged in this world, this card suggests: now is the time to consider what you want to create.
Let it be the home of your dreams, where you'll be greeted with love, where you can open up, restore yourself, and gather strength for new accomplishments.
Find your home, whether a physical space or a state of comfort within you. Remember, home begins in your heart.
When harmony reigns within you, home becomes wherever you are.
May the Universe guide you toward your space of peace, joy, and love. So be it.

title: Acceptance
description:
Acceptance is the key to harmony and abundance. I open my heart and accept every gift the Universe sends me.
I accept money, success, love, happiness, health, romantic relationships, and wellbeing for myself and my loved ones.
I accept every moment of life, every cell of my body. I release tension and allow myself to be relaxed, alive, and open to the world.
Acceptance is not only about yourself; it is about the ability to share with others.
I not only accept gifts, but generously share what comes to me.
Expecting nothing in return, I give with joy, whether it's support, attention, or material goods.
It's important to remember: the more you give, the more you receive. There is no selfishness in this; it is simply true.
Through giving, space opens for new possibilities and blessings.
But acceptance is not only about giving. It is also the ability to receive.
Often we feel shy about accepting others' gifts, thinking we must give something back in return.
But in truth, real acceptance requires an open heart, a readiness to acknowledge that we are worthy of it.
If someone gives you something without conditions, without expectation, allow yourself to accept it with gratitude.
There's no need to fear accepting without obligation.
Acceptance is the game of life. We often play our own private games, without noticing how the world around us moves us along its own track.
All of this is part of a greater process, and it is precisely in accepting, in giving and receiving, that we begin to understand our true desires and goals.
Money, success, emotions, all of this becomes an important part of the game.
But it's important to understand that the goal is not the destination; it's the journey.
The wisdom of acceptance lies in being present in the moment, giving with an open heart, and allowing yourself to receive with gratitude.
When you allow yourself to be in the flow of life, when you're not afraid to give and to receive, you create space for true abundance.
Accept this moment, your life, yourself. Let the currents of the Universe flow through you. Give yourself the right to feel joy and to share that joy.
And everything else will follow.

title: Whisper of Fate
description:
Life speaks to us always; it whispers, it shouts, it knocks on doors, it leaves signs, do you see them?
The Whisper of Fate card reminds you that the Universe constantly communicates with us through symbols, numbers, phenomena of nature, encounters, and even through animals.
You walk down the street, and a dog barks at you, perhaps it sees something you're missing.
The clock reads 11:11, a sign of synchronicity, an invitation to reflect on your thoughts and actions.
Signs around us are like beacons on the boundless ocean of life; they guide us, hint to us, warn us.
Every sign carries its own vibration, its own message. A warm wind may hint at ease to come; thunder may warn of a storm, not only in the weather, but within.
If something causes you discomfort, that too is a sign. Perhaps you've strayed from your path, or you're surrounded by energy that isn't yours.
Don't be afraid to see this and correct it.
Signs don't simply appear. They demand your attention. They enter your life to guide it.
Give thanks for them, even when they're unpleasant. Cockroaches or ants in your home are not simply insects.
Perhaps this is a signal for change, for parting with something excessive, for cleansing your space, for realizing that something no longer serves you.
The Whisper of Fate card reminds you: not every sign will be pleasant. Sometimes, through signs, the Universe asks you to stop; sometimes, to move forward.
Sometimes a sign arrives as a number, an animal, a chance phrase. Sometimes it is a place.
For example, the island of Phangan, where this card was written, and where its final part is being written, the island of Bali, are themselves living manifestations of a sign, a reminder of bliss, harmony, and that even within life's chaos there are corners of peace.
Have you ever noticed how words or names resonate within you?
"Angel", "Demon", "Love", "Phangan", each of these vibrations awakens something of its own inside you.
These vibrations connect you to something greater than your current moment.
Perhaps the word "Phangan" will become a key for you, a starting point for change, or, on the contrary, a reminder of what was forgotten.
This card says that signs don't simply exist, they wait for you to notice them.
Sometimes they are gentle, sometimes loud and bold. The Universe wants you to understand its language.
To see a sign means to step out of illusion and begin living more consciously.
But don't be fooled: awareness is not a final destination, but an ongoing process.
Each of us loses it at times, only to find it again, as though rediscovering ourselves anew.
Listen. Notice. Give thanks. Go where the whisper of fate calls you.

title: Bliss
description:
Sometimes life reminds us of the most important thing, how vital it is to savor the moment.
The Flow of Bliss card invites you to remember that true happiness and joy lie not in the material, but in the ability to live each second with a sense of inner delight.
This is a state where you feel harmony with the world, your body, and your soul. It is a moment when you allow yourself simply to be.
Your life can be filled with countless sources of joy: the sound of waves on a beach, a favorite melody, a pleasant conversation, a walk in the forest, the smell of rain, or the moment when the sun touches the horizon.
Delight is not something to be sought far away. It is a feeling here and now.
It can be so simple and pure that it needs no outer trappings, no approval from others.
However, many are afraid to allow themselves to relax and feel pleasure. Sometimes society judges us for our joys; sometimes we ourselves feel guilty for enjoying life.
But was life created only for labor, suffering, and worry? This card reminds you that the state of flow is a natural gift.
A gift we often ignore, afraid of seeming too frivolous.
Bliss is energy that must be directed wisely. When you're relaxed and feeling joy, your actions become more productive, and your decisions more conscious.
In this state, you create from love, not from fear.
You become open to new ideas, new emotions, and new possibilities.
This doesn't mean you must be in bliss constantly, but knowing how to return to this state is a great skill.
This card also reminds you of the exchange of energy. When you share your joy with others, you multiply it.
A simple smile, a kind word, a sincere wish for happiness, all of this makes the world better.
Bless those who cross your path, even in your thoughts. And let the flow of your energy become a gift to others.
And one last thing: bliss requires nothing external. It can be the instant you feel alive, simply breathing, feeling your body, and recognizing your place in this world.
If you've ever doubted you were capable of more, the Flow of Bliss card reminds you: you are already enough. Simply accept this. Live. Love.
Rejoice.
And remember: sometimes the best magic is knowing how to be happy right now.

title: Shadow of Actions
description:
The great power of our actions lies in their duality. Every step we take carries either light or darkness within it.
The Shadow of Actions card reveals to you the world of deeds called bad, and makes you consider: what actually is a bad deed?
Who judges where the line falls between light and darkness?
Bad deeds are lessons. They come to test you, to make you look within.
Often these are temptations we choose, consciously or unconsciously. Lies, manipulation, grievances, betrayal, all of these are links in a chain leading us toward awareness and cleansing.
But it's important to remember: for every action that disrupts harmony, we inevitably pay. We pay with time, with energy, with lost opportunities, or with suffering.
Bad deeds are not always great evils. They can be words we failed to say, help we refused to give, or actions that wounded others.
Sometimes we commit them to protect ourselves or our loved ones. And that's all right, for we are human.
However, the key to freeing yourself from the weight of darkness is awareness and sincere repentance.
The shadow of actions teaches balance. For every darkness, there is light. A bad deed, if it is recognized, can become the beginning of a great path of cleansing.
